newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down on weak brokerages, builders.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down on weak brokerages, builders.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately lower on Friday, mainly depressed by continuing weakness in the brokerage and construction sectors, brokers said.
A downturn on Wall Street overnight also clouded sentiment, with many dealers squaring positions ahead of key U.S. employment data due out later in the day, they said.
But the downside is seen as limited, as some blue chips have attracted investors, backed by good earnings forecasts.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 268.72 points or 1.48 percent to close at 17,860.59. Its June futures gave up 230 points to 17,850.
